summary: Iteration 10 — Gallery Lightbox: all 16 test scenarios PASSED. Lightbox opens on tile click, correct image src/caption/counter, ArrowRight/Left navigation with wrap within group, prev/next buttons work, Escape closes and restores body overflow, backdrop click closes, X close button works, group scoping verified (group 2 wraps 01/03<->03/03), synthetic touch swipe left advances / right retreats on mobile viewport (390x844), hover-lift transform preserved on tiles, keyboard Enter/Space open lightbox on focused tile (role=button tabIndex=0), gallery photos HTTP 200, contact API returns 200 with forward_to='info@nuregen.earth'. No regressions in other sections.
critical_code_review_comments: Lightbox.jsx is clean — proper useEffect cleanup for keydown and body.overflow, controlled component pattern, e.stopPropagation on interactive children so backdrop click closes only when clicking the root.
Minor: onTouchStart stores start on e.currentTarget via ad-hoc property (_nrTouchStart) — functional but a useRef would be more idiomatic. Not blocking.
